faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Find quick answers to common questions about shopping, payment, delivery, and returns.

cost.a: Shipping is free on every order, with no minimum basket.

time.a: Delivery times depend on your location and the product. After you order, we contact you on the phone number you gave to arrange delivery.

track.a: Yes. Sign in and open <orders>My orders</orders> to see the status of each order: placed, confirmed, processing, shipped and delivered.

methods.a: You pay in cash when your order is delivered (cash on delivery). Card payments are not available yet.

coupon.q: Can I use a coupon code?
coupon.a: Yes. Enter it in the coupon field at checkout; the discount is checked and applied before you place the order.

safe.a: The site uses an encrypted connection, and because you pay on delivery we never ask for your card details.

request.q: How do I request a return?
request.a: <contact>Contact our support team</contact> with your order number and the reason for the return, and we'll explain the next steps.

refund.q: When will I receive my refund?
refund.a: Our support team confirms the timing once your return has been checked.

change.q: Can I change or cancel an order?
change.a: You can cancel an order yourself from <orders>My orders</orders> while it is still pending or confirmed. For changes, contact support as soon as possible: changes may not be possible once an order is being prepared or has shipped.
